turns.user: Petra, what happened to the Dreaming City?
turns.agent: The Dreaming City was the Awoken's most closely guarded secret. Riven, the last Ahamkara, was Taken. She granted one final wish as she died. Her death is your calling.
I should have known. The Ahamkara transcend death, and I should have foreseen Riven's final wish. That failure is mine.
The Blind Well enables transit between this reality and the Ascendant Plane. Ley Lines connect the two. We must hold this location at all costs, Guardian.
Unfortunately, this gate opens both ways. Xivu Arath, Hive god of war, is trying to secure it for an invasion so she can capture Savathûn.
